title: Buttons | Apple Developer Documentation - [Help buttons](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons\#Help-buttons)
claim: Use a help button within a view, not in the window frame.** For example, avoid placing a help button in a toolbar or status bar.
supporting_text: **Use a help button within a view, not in the window frame.** For example, avoid placing a help button in a toolbar or status bar.
